name: Payment Record
documentation: Logical data entity representing a persisted payment transaction record. Defined in the 'payment_records' database table with the following attributes: 'id' (VARCHAR 64, primary key), 'account_id' (VARCHAR 64, the owning account), 'amount' (DECIMAL 10,2, the monetary value of the transaction), and 'created_at' (TIMESTAMP, automatically set to the record creation time). This data object is accessed by the PaymentService Application Component during payment processing and status retrieval.
